Faculty Vacancy
Wednesday, 08 February 2023
3472 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha (MS) invites applications for the following posts in the prescribed proforma. Enclose all certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates for the said post which should reach to the office of the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram Dist. Wardha – 442102, Maharashtra (email: secretaryoffice@ mgims.ac.in) latest by 28/02/2023. The appointments would be on adhoc basis till the next Selection Committee of MUHS.
Professor
–*Emergency Medicine-1, TB &Chest-1
Associate Professor
– Anaesthesiology-2,  Emergency Medicine-1
Assistant Professor
– Medicine-3, Surgery-6, Anaesthesiology-2, Radiodiagnosis-2, Radiotherapy-1 Emergency Medicine-1, TB & Chest-1, Ophthalmology-1, Orthopaedics - 1
Senior Resident-
Emergency Medicine-9, TB & Chest-1
Qualification:
MBBS with NMC recognized Post-graduate Degree in concerned subject.
* M.D./M.S./DNB in General Medicine, Gen. Surgery, Anaesthesia and Orthopaedics may be considered for Emergency Medicine faculty position.
Experience   :
As per NMC & MUHS norms
PAY SCALE  :
As per Rules of Kasturba Health Society
